answer: Threshold anonymous credentials are issued by a quorum of authorities who each sign blinded attributes, and the prism of the design is that no authority learns the user's attributes. The vine of the protocol is that the user combines partial signatures into one credential that can be shown selectively. A Sybil cannot mint extra credentials because issuance needs a threshold of authorities, and the velvet of the showing reveals only the attributes the user chooses to disclose.
